name: f2a_uncentered_document_formula_wearing_v1
formula: For each 40-sample, 8-channel native EMG window, compute M=X^T X/T without subtracting channel means; C=(1-.05)M+.05 trace(M)/8 I; divide by max(trace(C),1e-12), then vectorize the upper triangle with sqrt(2) on off-diagonals.
source_fit: Fit the Rest-noise F0v2 source thresholds, feature input contract, source-trial StandardScaler and class-balanced LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=2000 random_state=20260924 on the user's training domain only. Apply unchanged to four target wearing domains; never fit on target windows.
evaluation: Match every source/target native trial identity to the frozen centered-F2a parent. Compare the uncentered candidate with frozen F0v2 and centered F2a on validation users; final users are descriptive only. Report pooled F1, log loss, minimum-user F1 and all saved probabilities. Do not promote from one axis.
boundary: This is a document-formula correction candidate on public eight-channel 200 Hz wearing data, not an own-device 250 Hz result, a prospective independent cohort, or a claim that uncentered covariance is always better.
